Description: 12 V bulk: holds the rail through the crank dip (11.4 V measured 2026-08-31)
bootstrap cap BST-SW

buck input cap, right at VIN. 50 V not 25 V: ceramics lose a lot of capacitance under DC bias, and this sits on a 14.6 V rail. (b-hydro used C89632; that part is down to single-digit stock at LCSC, so this board takes the basic-part equivalent.)
5 V bulk near the ESP 5V pin
10 V zener gate-source: clamps Q1 Vgs within the AO3401A +-12 V limit
Input TVS. b-hydro skipped this on purpose (indoor). A generator pad is not indoor: the starter is a large inductive load. 16 V standoff clears the 14.6 V charging rail.
PSM712 RS-485 TVS on the controller pair (asymmetric -7/+12 V, the RS-485 standard part)
GREEN LED -- Modbus online: the controller is answering. Sits under a light pipe in the lid; see enclosure docs.
BLUE LED -- Wi-Fi associated. Sits under a light pipe in the lid; see enclosure docs.
RED LED -- a generator fault is active. Sits under a light pipe in the lid; see enclosure docs.
YELLOW LED -- transmit: driven from DE, so it needs no GPIO and proves the bridge is actually talking. Sits under a light pipe in the lid; see enclosure docs.
1.1 A hold / 2.2 A trip on the 5 V rail, below the buck's 3.2 A limit
SMD1812-200C-30V, 2 A hold / 4 A trip, 30 V: InfoHub supply, independent of F1
Screw terminal 5.08 2P: +12 V (harness red/grey) and GND (harness black)

120R termination jumper, controller side. LEAVE OPEN by default: 368 consecutive error-free block reads at 9600 8E1 on 2026-08-31 with an unterminated adapter, and at 104 us per bit reflections settle ~1000x faster than the sampling instant. Fit only if CRC errors appear.
Screw terminal 2.54 2P to the ABC controller: A and B only. The harness ground arrives on J1 and is the same net, so a separate ground pin here would be redundant. Swap A/B if the bus stays silent.
Screw terminal 2.54 4P to the InfoHub: +12 V (fused by F2), GND, A, B
External LED header: GND, PWR, WIFI, BUS, FAULT, TX
SWPA6045S100MT shielded 6x6
P-MOSFET reverse-polarity protection, 4 A -- carries BOTH our load and the InfoHub passthrough
Q1 gate pull-down; ~0.4 mA through D1 keeps the clamp in its characterised region
buck EN pull-up (always on)
bus termination, controller side
D5 series resistor, ~4 mA.
D6 series resistor, ~4 mA. Small value: blue/green Vf leaves little headroom on 3.3 V.
ESP32 socket row
Sync buck 3.8-32 V in, fixed 5 V 2 A, TSOT-23-6
